newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi share index rises in fairly active market.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi share index rises in fairly active market.

text.p: The Narobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-shares index recovered on Wednesday as share prices for some leading stocks gained marginally in a fairly active market, brokers said.
The index rose 10.62 points to stand at 3074.83. Turnover was posted at 13.811 million shillings on 416,379 shares from 7.660 million shillings on 294,436 shares on Tuesday.
"A few stock prices advanced while the rest continued to hold steady involving good volumes," he said.
Uchumi Supermarket was the most active with a total of 102,690 shares traded at 39 shillings from the three -day special board..
Kenya Airways rose to 11.25 eased to 11 but corrected to 11.20 on 92,911 shares and Nation Printers & Publishers rose a shilling to 105.
Kenya Commercial Bank held steady at 55, Barclays Bank rose to 110 but eased back to 105, National Bank of Kenya traded 63,200 shares at 18 unchanged from Tuesday.
Among plantations, Brooke Bond fell a shilling to 176, Rea Vipingo eased to 11 from 11.20 while Sasini Tea & Coffee rose 50 cents to 51.50.
British American Tobbacoo rose to 69 from 68, Crown Berger gained to 10.10 from 10.05, East African Packing rose a shilling to 71.
